{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue (though not needed for conversion rate, but for consistency)
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
filtered_data = data[
    (data['customer_segment'] == 'new') & 
    (data['channel'] == 'paid_search')
]

# Calculate conversion rate: fraction of converted orders
conversion_rate = filtered_data['converted'].mean()

# Print the result
print(f"Number of NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH: {len(filtered_data)}")
print(f"Number of converted orders among them: {filtered_data['converted'].sum()}")
print(f"Conversion rate: {conversion_rate}")"}
